description: Defines the class hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security, which provides APIs for managing WiFi Access Point security parameters such as modes supported, security mode enabled, WEP keys, PSK, passphrase, rekey interval, and RADIUS server details.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security
classes.description: A class providing methods to get WiFi Access Point security parameters and configurations.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_ModesSupported
methods.description: Retrieves the list of security modes supported by the Access Point.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_ModeEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves the currently enabled security mode.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_WEPKey
methods.description: Retrieves the WEP key in hexadecimal string format.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_KeyPassphrase
methods.description: Retrieves the passphrase used to generate the PSK.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_RekeyingInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the interval for key re-generation.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_RadiusServerIPAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the RADIUS server.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_RadiusServerPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port number of the RADIUS server.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_Security_RadiusSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the secret used for RADIUS server handshaking.
